notes: Adds Tor exit-node blocking to Security Settings: rejects any Free Service Gateway request coming from a known Tor exit IP, checked against a list that refreshes automatically every hour (with a manual 'Refresh Tor list now' button too). This targets abuse that rotates through a different Tor IP every few requests, which per-IP blocking alone can never catch up with - confirmed from your own request log that most of the ongoing flood is coming through Tor exit ranges. Off by default - turn it on under Security > Settings and click 'Refresh Tor list now' once after installing. No database update needed for this update.
